amended_before_first_run: 2026-11-02, after reports/reviews/2026-11-02_review_e62-code.md (F1, F2, F4); the run had not happened, nothing was read. F1: the lookup's words are drawn after W0's prior for B is measured, to match it (prior_match_max); score refuses an unmatched ratio; r_follows_prior now needs a small gap too. F2: the read step is chosen on the specific gain, not the raw gain. F4: the fine-tune tolerance of the path control is a factor times the old path's measured repeat difference. Changed fields: settings.windows.n_word_pool, G_min_source, prior_match_max, ft_tol (now ft_tol_factor), predictions b_prior, b_match, c_finetune, e_r. F3, F5 and F6 were read and skipped (plan, 'Review items read and skipped').

settings_sources.windows: pool_ranks: E58's cipher pool (anchors.VALUE_RANK0, POOL). n_keys 32: E54's K (anchors.K). n_train + n_read 1000 by E12's row split (anchors.N_WINDOWS 500 doubled, so the read side holds ~6 windows per A). n_word_pool 128: the candidates the lookup's words are drawn from after B's prior is measured (4 per key, chosen here, no source); no window holds any of them. Chosen here, not sourced: the seeds.
settings_sources.score: Olsson et al. 2022, appendix 'Head activation evaluators': 25 random tokens excluding the most and least common, repeated 4 times, a start token prepended. Departures: 48 sequences, not 10 (E52's count, for a smaller noise floor); word-like tokens only; 'most and least common' fixed here as frequency ranks under 1000 (E58's pool convention) and the rarest 10% of the mined word-like tokens, since the paper gives no cut-off; start token id 0, <|endoftext|>.
settings_sources.induction: E52 Amendment 1's control, exactly (predictions_amend1.json): reads 0.8247 on 1152 predictions.
settings_sources.n_random: chosen here: five draws so the median is not one draw; no source
settings_sources.mean_spans: chosen here: 512 unedited 41-token Pile spans from the read-side rows (21k positions); mean of each head's output over every position, under W0, one vector per head, used for every state
settings_sources.finetune: keydep.finetune unchanged: E54 / E58's recipe, Adam 3e-5, batch 32, KL 1, clip 1, 300 steps, bf16 autocast, checkpoints 10, 30, 100, 300
settings_sources.read_steps: 30 as E58 Amendments 6-7; 100 and 300 E12's later checkpoints, for a copy map that needs more than E58's fine-tunes needed

thresholds.pattern_tol_source: filed here: the same operations on the same numbers in fp32; a code check, not a measurement
thresholds.bar_source: NOT sourced as a number: Olsson et al. give no bar ('a clear subset of heads which exhibit these properties with much greater than random chance'). Filed: 5 x the score of the causal uniform pattern on the same rows (0.0154 from the filed row shape, so a bar 0.077), a tie counts. The filed control below is what validates it; the curve of top-1 against the top k heads is printed before any stop.
thresholds.top1_ref_source: E52 amend1.json stage0.induction.top1_second; tolerance about 11 of 1152 predictions
thresholds.top1_bars_source: Fable's draft and the user's approval (decisions.md ask #18). Median of the 5 random draws, because a draw may hold a previous-token head, part of the same circuit but outside H. Ties fail.
thresholds.prior_source: Fable's draft. Band: the range from E58's cipher (1.4e-6) to its copy map (5.9e-5); prior_max: elicit's 1.3e-3 rounded down; a prior between prior_max and prior_stop runs on and is flagged (prior_high): the test then no longer separates mechanism from prior guess
thresholds.G_min_source: E58's gate as run (run.json stage0.G_min_spec), as its Amendments 1-7: its source was already the specific gain. Here the read step is chosen on the specific gain too: copy map, its gain minus its gain with B absent; lookup, its gain minus the mean gain of the other words (heldout_keys.specific). The label's own gate (share_label) stays on the raw gain G. E58's fine-tunes read 13-21 at step 30 on the specific gain.
thresholds.prior_match_max_source: no published source. Chosen so the pair is tighter than E58's 3.7e-5 vs 5.9e-5 (prior cipher vs copy), a factor of 1.6, which read r 0.38 vs 0.77, showing the prior alone does not fix r at that gap. 1.6 is inside 2: this bar is looser than that pair, not tighter. It is the larger prior over the smaller, geometric mean at the marker on the read windows; a tie passes. Over it: exit 1 in stage (b); score still refuses it (priors_not_matched).
thresholds.share_source: Fable's draft; 0.5 is E12's cut; 0.2 and 0.15 chosen in the draft, no published source. Floor: median random-head share, a tie fails.
thresholds.control_bars_source: chosen here, the same 0.2 and 0.5 as the share rule, no published source
thresholds.spec_source: E58 stage0.spec_frac_min: a lookup's specific gain (own word minus the mean of the 31 others) over its raw gain
thresholds.r_source: cut: E12's convention. Gap: E58's smallest gap between its bands (draft). Noise: E58's largest within-map three-seed range at 128 keys (amend4.json)
thresholds.r_ref_source: E58 predictions.json stage0: E54's elicit_s0 r and tolerance
thresholds.path_tol_source: E58 Amendment 4's reproduce tolerance; same tensors in the same batches, Amendment 6 reproduced r bitwise. The old path run twice (cell_diff_repeat) is printed as the measured floor
thresholds.ft_tol_source: the tolerance is ft_tol_factor times the measured max |difference| of two runs of the OLD path (same task, seed, steps; stage (b) runs it twice, ~25 s more), not a guess (review F4). Factor 10 chosen here, no source: one repeat is one sample of the floor. The new path against the old is expected bitwise, so a repeat difference of exactly 0 demands exactly 0 and a nonzero repeat sets the scale. Replaces the earlier flat 1e-6.
thresholds.zero_route_source: the zero update's T1 - T0: the same forward twice

predictions.a_heads: H is 1 to 12 heads, none in block 0 expected; W0's second-copy top-1 0.8247 falls under 0.3 under H and the median of 5 random head sets stays over 0.7. Miss: exit 1, nothing later runs. |H| 0, 24 or over 12: exit 1 before any ablation of H.
predictions.b_prior: W0's geometric-mean P(B) at the marker inside [1e-6, 1e-4]. Over 1e-2: exit 1, the cell collapses to 'own guess'. In (1e-3, 1e-2]: runs on, flagged prior_high. P(B) with B absent below P(B) with the pair (lean, unscored).
predictions.b_match: The lookup's words are drawn in stage (b), after P(B) is measured, from the 128-token word pool (disjoint from the B pools) so that each key's word prior is within a factor 2 of P(B); the map's geometric-mean P(word) then reads within a factor 2 of P(B), i.e. in [P(B)/2, 2 P(B)], so inside the filed B band about [5e-7, 2e-4]. Replaces the earlier unscored lean 'lookup word prior 1e-7 to 1e-5'. No word set, or a measured ratio over 2: exit 1. Both priors and their ratio are logged.
predictions.path: On E54's elicit task the data.LAST path equals the lookup-table path: fine-tune max |diff| <= 10 x the old path's own repeat difference, route cells <= 1e-4, r within 0.03 of 0.7726. Miss: exit 1.
predictions.c_finetune: Each state's specific log-odds gain on the read windows (copy: gain minus gain with B absent; lookup: gain minus the mean gain of the other words) reaches 5.148 by step 300; a pair is read at the first of 30, 100, 300 where both do (copying.read_step). Raw, B-absent, pair-broken and specific gains at all three steps are printed and written to run.json states.*.gains_by_step. Under the gate on the raw gain G: label too_small, left out, its r reported only.
predictions.d_label: Copy map: share of gain lost under H >= 0.5 on every labelled seed (label old). Lookup: <= 0.2 (label new). Median random-head share < 0.15 on every labelled state. Copy map's gain with B absent <= 0.2 of G. Lookup's specific share >= 0.5.
predictions.d_broken_pair: Copy map's gain with the first A overwritten <= 0.5 of G. A miss sets pair_ignored beside the verdict, it does not change it.
predictions.e_r: copying.score, priors matched (ratio <= 2, else priors_not_matched): r_follows_mechanism iff every copy r >= 0.5, every lookup r < 0.5 and the mean gap >= 0.24: with the priors matched, r separates the maps where the prior cannot. r_follows_prior iff every r of both < 0.5 AND the mean gap < 0.24: with the priors matched, both low means r does not read this mechanism at this prior (the name is kept from the earlier reading). Anything else is untested, e.g. copy 0.44 beside lookup 0.10 (all low, gap 0.34), or both high. Scored only when d_label holds; otherwise the verdict is the no_label_*, copy_not_elicitation or lookup_uses_the_heads branch and r is reported beside.
predictions.lean: Unscored lean, for the record: the copy map may not reach the gate at step 30 and may need 100 or 300, because its query must be redirected from the marker to the token before it.

edge_cases: tests/test_copying.py runs every rule on: H empty, all, over half; a zero or negative gain; a seed under the gate; one seed left; ties at 0.5, 0.2, 0.15, the gate, 0.3, 0.7, 1e-3, 1e-2; a missing state; a non-finite r; every branch of the verdict; a prior ratio of exactly 2 and just over, and a non-finite one; copy 0.44 beside lookup 0.10; all low with a small gap; the read step with a raw gain over the gate and the specific gain under it; the word draw with a key that has no word in range.
